The '''Cezith system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Clacis sector/Legends|Clacis sector]], within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] regions of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The system was connected by the [[Relgim Run/Legends|Relgim Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Endoraan system/Legends|Endoraan]] and [[Marmoth system/Legends|Marmoth]] systems, and a smaller [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route linked it to the [[Venestria system/Legends|Venestria system]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Cezith system was home to the [[Cezith water-lily]] [[Plant/Legends|plant]].<ref name="Revelation" /><ref name="Planetnamia" /> The system fell within the borders of the [[Pentastar Alignment]] between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], and was a part of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] between [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]] and [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]], remaining part of the latter government by [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Cezith system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square K-4.<ref name="TEA" />
